verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a financial-data connectivity platform, but the evidence pack contains no documented way to delete a member/connection or user, stop aggregation, or purge held data. The only deletion evidence covers webhooks, an adjacent feature. The note that MX aggregates members every 24 hours describes collection, not severance.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can sever and clean up — a documented way to delete a connection or user and have the platform stop collecting and purge held data
